name: M5 Sarcastic Joke Scroller - Portal Hater Edition
author: coreymillia + GitHub Copilot CLI
description: Complete sarcastic joke scroller with 3,542 hilariously brutal jokes, random auto-scroll, cycling font colors, and universal M5StickC compatibility. Perfect font size for maximum readability!
features: 📱 Universal firmware works on Plus1.1 and Plus2
🎲 Random auto-scroll mode for endless entertainment
🌈 10 cycling font colors via power button
📖 Perfect size 2 font optimized for long jokes
💾 Position & color memory - remembers where you left off
✨ Clean UI with joke counter and controls display

joke_collection.style: Sarcastic AI responses and witty comebacks
joke_collection.themes: Tech humor, social media satire, modern life commentary
examples: You're the human equivalent of a loading screen that never finishes.
I bet you ask GPS for confirmation even when you know the way.

color_cycling.feedback: Screen flashes in new color when changed

requirements: No WiFi or network required - works offline

installation.note: Same firmware works on both Plus1.1 and Plus2!

setup_instructions: 1. Flash firmware to M5StickC using M5Burner
2. Device auto-detects Plus1.1 vs Plus2 on startup
3. Press Button A/C to browse jokes manually
4. Press Button B to enable random auto-scroll
5. Press Power Button to cycle font colors
6. Device remembers position and color on reboot
how_to_use: 📖 Browse jokes with A (next) and C (previous) buttons
🎲 Enable auto-scroll with B button for hands-free entertainment
🌈 Cycle colors with Power button to find your favorite
💾 Device remembers your last joke and color choice
⚡ Auto-scroll shows random jokes every 5 seconds
🎯 Perfect for coffee breaks, waiting rooms, or just laughs!
